component.name: DiagPanel
component.script:
sub init() m.baseUrl = "http://10.0.0.159:8080" buildChrome() m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "ApiTask") m.task.observeField("result", "onResult") m.issueOffset = 0 m.issues = [] end sub
sub buildChrome() bg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bg.translation = [0, 0] bg.width = 1280 bg.height = 596 bg.color = "0x0D1117FF"
' -- top summary bar ------------------------------------- topBar = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") topBar.translation = [36, 12] topBar.width = 1208 topBar.height = 40 topBar.color = "0x161B22FF"
titleLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") titleLbl.translation = [52, 18] titleLbl.text = " SYSTEM DIAGNOSTICS" titleLbl.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" titleLbl.color = "0xE6EDF3FF"
m.statusLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.statusLbl.translation = [900, 22] m.statusLbl.text = "Loading..." m.statusLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.statusLbl.color = "0x8B949EFF"
' -- big stat tiles (row of 5) --------------------------- tileLabels = ["Routes", "Functions", "Python Files", "Issues", "Errors"] m.tileVals = [] tileW = 230 for i = 0 to 4 tileBg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") tileBg.translation = [36 + i * (tileW + 4), 62] tileBg.width = tileW tileBg.height = 88 tileBg.color = "0x161B22FF"
kl = m.top.createChild("Label") kl.translation = [36 + i * (tileW + 4) + 12, 68] kl.text = tileLabels[i] kl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" kl.color = "0x8B949EFF"
vl = m.top.createChild("Label") vl.translation = [36 + i * (tileW + 4) + 12, 96] vl.text = "-" vl.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" vl.color = "0xE6EDF3FF" m.tileVals.push(vl) end for
' -- issues list ----------------------------------------- issHdr = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") issHdr.translation = [36, 160] issHdr.width = 1208 issHdr.height = 28 issHdr.color = "0x21262DFF"
issHdrLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") issHdrLbl.translation = [52, 164] issHdrLbl.text = "ISSUES" issHdrLbl.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" issHdrLbl.color = "0x58A6FFFF"
sevHdr = m.top.createChild("Label") sevHdr.translation = [200, 164] sevHdr.text = "SEVERITY" sevHdr.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" sevHdr.color = "0x58A6FFFF"
fileHdr = m.top.createChild("Label") fileHdr.translation = [400, 164] fileHdr.text = "FILE" fileHdr.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" fileHdr.color = "0x58A6FFFF"
m.issueGroup = m.top.createChild("Group") m.issueGroup.translation = [0, 192] end sub
function load(args as Dynamic) m.statusLbl.text = "* Fetching..." m.task.url = m.baseUrl + "/sys/diagnostics" end function
sub onResult() data = m.task.result if data = invalid or data.doesExist("error") errMsg = "no data" if data <> invalid then errMsg = data.error m.statusLbl.text = "X " + errMsg ' fallback: try the scan API m.task.url = m.baseUrl + "/api/diagnostics" return end if
' populate tiles summary = invalid if data.doesExist("summary") then summary = data.summary if summary = invalid then summary = data
tileKeys = [["routes", "route_count"], ["functions", "function_count"], ["python_files", "total_files"], ["issues", "total_issues"], ["errors", "error_count"]] for i = 0 to 4 v = "-" keys = tileKeys[i] for each k in keys if v = "-" and summary.doesExist(k) then v = str(summary[k]).trim() end for m.tileVals[i].text = v ' colour issues/errors red if > 0 if (i = 3 or i = 4) and v <> "-" and val(v) > 0 m.tileVals[i].color = "0xF85149FF" else if (i = 3 or i = 4) and v = "0" m.tileVals[i].color = "0x3FB950FF" end if end for
' collect issues list m.issues = [] issueKeys = ["issues_list", "issues", "errors_list", "warnings"] for each k in issueKeys if data.doesExist(k) and type(data[k]) = "roArray" m.issues = data[k] exit for end if end for m.issueOffset = 0 renderIssues()
dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") dt.ToLocalTime() m.statusLbl.text = "Updated " + str(dt.GetHours()).trim() + ":" + rp(dt.GetMinutes()) end sub
sub renderIssues() while m.issueGroup.getChildCount() > 0 m.issueGroup.removeChildIndex(0) end while
maxRows = 9 rowH = 38 y = 0 endIdx = m.issueOffset + maxRows - 1 if endIdx >= m.issues.count() then endIdx = m.issues.count() - 1
if m.issues.count() = 0 empty = m.issueGroup.createChild("Label") empty.translation = [52, 8] empty.text = "OK No issues detected." empty.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" empty.color = "0x3FB950FF" return end if
for i = m.issueOffset to endIdx item = m.issues[i]
rowBg = m.issueGroup.createChild("Rectangle") rowBg.translation = [36, y] rowBg.width = 1208 rowBg.height = rowH - 1 if i mod 2 = 0 then rowBg.color = "0x0D1117FF" else rowBg.color = "0x161B22FF"
msg = "" sev = "" file = "" if type(item) = "roString" or type(item) = "String" msg = item else if type(item) = "roAssociativeArray" msg = safeStr(item, "message", safeStr(item, "text", safeStr(item, "msg", str(item).trim()))) sev = safeStr(item, "severity", safeStr(item, "level", safeStr(item, "type", ""))) file = safeStr(item, "file", safeStr(item, "path", "")) end if
m_makeLbl(m.issueGroup, 52, y + 9, msg, "0xE6EDF3FF", 140) m_makeLbl(m.issueGroup, 200, y + 9, UCase(sev), sevColor(sev), 192) m_makeLbl(m.issueGroup, 400, y + 9, file, "0x8B949EFF", 840)
y = y + rowH end for
if m.issues.count() > maxRows hint = m.issueGroup.createChild("Label") hint.translation = [36, y + 4] hint.text = "^ v scroll (" + str(m.issues.count()).trim() + " issues)" hint.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" hint.color = "0x8B949EFF" end if end sub
sub m_makeLbl(grp as Object, x as Integer, y as Integer, text as String, color as String, w = 300 as Integer) lbl = grp.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [x, y] lbl.text = text lbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" lbl.color = color lbl.width = w lbl.truncateOnDelimiter = "..." end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "down" and m.issueOffset + 9 < m.issues.count() m.issueOffset = m.issueOffset + 1 renderIssues() return true else if key = "up" and m.issueOffset > 0 m.issueOffset = m.issueOffset - 1 renderIssues() return true end if return false end function
function sevColor(s as String) as String sl = LCase(s) if sl = "error" or sl = "critical" then return "0xF85149FF" if sl = "warning" or sl = "warn" then return "0xD29922FF" return "0x8B949EFF" end function
